tools.name: goto
tools.description: move to a target receptacle or location

receptacle.description: the receptacle or location this action acts on

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: take
tools.description: pick up an object from a receptacle or location

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the receptacle or location that currently holds it

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: put
tools.description: place an object into or onto a target receptacle

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the receptacle or surface to place it into or onto

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: open
tools.description: open a receptacle that can be opened

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: close
tools.description: close a receptacle that is currently open

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: toggle
tools.description: toggle the state of an object, such as switching a lamp on or off

object.description: the object this action acts on

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

tools.name: use
tools.description: use an object, such as turning on a lamp

object.description: the object this action acts on

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

tools.name: clean
tools.description: clean an object using a receptacle or cleaning location

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the receptacle or cleaning location used to clean it

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: heat
tools.description: heat an object using a receptacle or heating appliance

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the receptacle or appliance used to heat it

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: cool
tools.description: cool an object using a receptacle or cooling appliance

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the receptacle or appliance used to cool it

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart receptacles sharing this name

tools.name: slice
tools.description: slice an object using a knife you are carrying

id_object.description: the instance number that tells apart objects sharing this name

receptacle.description: the knife used to slice it; despite the slot name this is an object, not a receptacle

id_receptacle.description: the instance number that tells apart knives sharing this name

tools.name: examine
tools.description: inspect a receptacle or object more closely

target.description: the object or receptacle to inspect

id_target.description: the instance number that tells apart targets sharing this name

tools.name: inventory
tools.description: list the objects currently being carried
